subject: Prepay drawdown eligibility matrix, invoice cutoff & release procedures
messages:
From: Emma Ruiz <emma@brightlane.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@brightlane.com
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Prepay release rules + invoice cutoff times for 2027-08 tranche

Hi Jordan,

Quick one as we ramp toward our August usage ramp: can you send over the exact eligibility matrix you use to authorize prepay drawdowns (milestone vs. consumption triggers) and the invoice cutoff times for each regional remit path?

Specifically we need:
- the gating conditions you check before releasing a tranche (e.g., usage threshold, outstanding invoice clearance, VAT forms on file)
- the lead time you need for invoice issuance vs. bank transfer (cutoff windows by USD/EUR)
- what to include on the remittance (invoice number + drawdown tag) so our AP can auto-apply credits

If possible, include a sample invoice PDF we can share with our accounting team. We need to finalize internal approval by Friday so please flag anything that typically causes delays.

Thanks —
Emma
Emma Ruiz
Finance Lead | BrightLane Analytics
[Attachment: BL_account_profile.csv]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Emma Ruiz <emma@brightlane.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Prepay release rules + invoice cutoff times for 2027-08 tranche

Emma —

Thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: we have a two-path release model (scheduled tranche releases tied to contract milestones + on-demand consumption drawdowns) and a set of pre-flight checks that must be green before funds are applied.

Attached: a one-page drawdown eligibility matrix and a sample invoice PDF. High level:
- Milestone releases: triggered by signed SOW milestone + acceptance; invoice sent T+1 business day, funds expected in 10 business days for USD remits.
- Consumption drawdowns: auto-release when committed spend usage reaches 70% of tranche or by explicit request from contract admin; invoice sent immediately and we can accelerate processing if we receive remittance confirmation and VAT evidence.
- Cutoffs: for same-week processing we need the signed invoice and remittance notice before 16:00 PT on the cutoff day. EUR remits need an extra 48 hours for intermediary bank processing.

Kimberly/Marcus — can you confirm the invoice numbering convention (we recently added a drawdown tag pattern) and whether we need any new VAT form(s) for BrightLane's EU entity?

Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: drawdown_eligibility_matrix.xlsx]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: (none)
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Prepay release rules + invoice cutoff times for 2027-08 tranche

Jordan —

Confirming invoice numbering and VAT notes: we use the format RDW-[ACCOUNT]-[YYYYMM]-INV-[NNN]. For drawdowns we append a suffix: RDW-[ACCOUNT]-[YYYYMM]-INV-[NNN]-DD[tranche#]. Example for BrightLane: RDW-BL-202708-INV-002-DD1. That suffix is required to have the credit applied to the tranche.

VAT: BrightLane's EU entity (BrightLane EU B.V.) is already on file for a reverse-charge flow but we need the final VAT registration number on the remittance advice to waive VAT on our invoice for EU accounting. If Emma can provide the VAT id and the local billing contact, we can flag the invoice not to include VAT.

Also note: bank cutoff windows we use (ops):
- USD domestic (ACH/US wires): cutoff 16:00 PT for same-day posting; recommended 3 business days for international bank clearance when wire route includes correspondent banks.
- EUR SEPA: cutoff 14:00 PT (which maps to 23:00 CET); allow 48-72 hours internal clearance.

Marcus — I'll need you to attach the sample invoice with the DD suffix and confirm the GL codes we should include for BrightLane (finance asked for GL tags to reconcile automatically).

Kimberly Park
Billing & Collections Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Emma Ruiz <emma@brightlane.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 17:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Prepay release rules + invoice cutoff times for 2027-08 tranche

Emma —

Attached are: (1) BL_invoice_sample_Q2-2027.pdf (sample invoice with drawdown suffix), and (2) the drawdown_eligibility_matrix.xlsx exported to show gating checks and processing notes. Key action items for your AP team:

1) When sending remittance advice, include: invoice number (RDW-BL-YYYYMM-INV-NNN-DD#), BrightLane VAT number (if EU entity), and payment reference: BL-TRANCHE-<deal id>.
2) For expedited drawdowns please email payments@redwood.com with "EXPEDITE-DD#" in the subject and attach bank confirmation (screenshot or payment reference). We will hold tranche for 24 hours to reconcile.
3) If you intend to fund via escrow/third-party payment platform, please notify us 5 business days in advance so we can map ledger allocations.

I also pasted a short checklist below that we run before releasing a tranche — feel free to include it in your internal SOPs:
- Contract milestone signed (if milestone release) OR consumption threshold crossed (>=70%)
- No outstanding tax evidence requests for the remitting entity
- Invoice number correctly formatted with DD suffix
- Remittance advice received and payment attempt visible in bank feed or 1st-party confirmation attached

I've added the HubSpot link to the deal for your reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/BL-2027-0921.

Attachments: BL_invoice_sample_Q2-2027.pdf, drawdown_eligibility_matrix.xlsx

Regards,
